reading.zh: 从左到右：config 读配置，sensors 收传感器，dead-reckoner 做航位推算，keyframe-policy 决定关键帧，session-recorder 记录会话，navigator 驱动在线导航线程；箭头是数据自传感器流向在线导航。
reading.en: Left to right: config reads settings, sensors collect data, dead-reckoner propagates pose, keyframe-policy decides keyframes, session-recorder logs the session and navigator drives the online navigation thread; arrows run from sensors into online navigation.
